title: FMASH: Advancing Traditional Chinese Medicine Formula Recommendation with Efficient Fusion of Multiscale Associations of Symptoms and Herbs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the therapeutic efficacy and recommendation accuracy of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formulas using AI. While TCM has a traditional background, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark specific religious doctrines, moral frameworks, or ethical theories. Mentions of 'clinical rationality' and avoiding 'toxic side effects' relate to practical medical outcomes, not a broader ethical or faith-based evaluation.
